text: Gillian, I have an urgent video call from Jamie. I'll connect you.
Gillian, I've got my memory back. I remember everything!
Your memory? So what about us, Jamie? Who are we?
Gillian, it's terrible. What we've done...
I can't tell you something like this over the videophone.
I would have been better off never remembering.
Okay, Jamie, calm down. I'll head out right now.
Where are you? Is it snowing?
I'm sorry, Gillian. I can't tell you.
Jamie, what are you talking about?
We have Professor Lorraine. We only require her cooperation for a short period here at the Kremlin.
So for now, I suggest you avoid doing anything foolish, Professor Seed.
